reply:
Correct. Async functions run on the main thread and don't create a thread—they just let the event loop handle other tasks between awaits. CPU-heavy work blocks the main thread regardless of async because there's nothing to await; the CPU is busy computing.

Web Workers are the only way to move CPU work off the main thread in the browser. That's the fix here.
